description: This file implements a command-line tool for connecting to an OpenClaw gateway. It includes options parsing, connection setup, communication with the gateway via WebSockets, handling snapshots and health checks, and printing output in JSON or plain text. It defines data structures, actors, and functions to manage the connection lifecycle and user options.

classes.name: ConnectOptions
classes.description: Holds and parses command-line options for the connect command.

classes.name: ConnectOutput
classes.description: Encapsulates the output data for a connection attempt, including status, errors, and relevant info.

classes.name: SnapshotStore
classes.description: An actor that stores and retrieves the latest HelloOk snapshot asynchronously.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a ConnectOptions struct.

methods.name: runConnect
methods.description: Main async function to execute the connect command: processes options, connects to gateway, performs health check, and prints results.

methods.name: printConnectOutput
methods.description: Formats and outputs the connection result in JSON or plain text.

methods.name: resolveGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Determines the gateway endpoint URL and credentials based on options and config.

methods.name: bestEffortEndpoint
methods.description: Attempts to resolve an endpoint, returns nil if fails.

methods.name: gatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a GatewayEndpoint from a raw URL and options.

methods.name: resolvedToken
methods.description: Determines the token to use, given options and config.

methods.name: resolvedPassword
methods.description: Determines the password to use, given options and config.

methods.name: resolveLocalHost
methods.description: Detects local network host based on bind address, including Tailnet route detection.
